content.value_statement: Long-form writing often stalls when research, outlines, and feedback are separate tasks. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through research-backed drafting.
actual_capabilities: Builds article outlines with hooks, sections, conclusions, and research tasks.
Guides research collection and citation formatting for claims and data.
Reviews introductions and suggests stronger hook options.
Provides section-level feedback on clarity, evidence, flow, and style.
Maintains a reference workflow and final review checklist.
limitations: Does not verify citations unless the assistant has browsing or source access.
Does not write in a user voice without examples or tone guidance.
Cannot guarantee publication accuracy without human review.
May need source rules for medical, legal, or financial topics.

use_cases.title: Plan a Blog Article
use_cases.description: Turn a topic into an outline with hooks, sections, research needs, and a publish checklist.

use_cases.title: Support Thought Leadership
use_cases.description: Develop a clear thesis, add evidence, and keep a consistent point of view across the draft.

use_cases.title: Improve Technical Tutorials
use_cases.description: Structure tutorial steps, review explanations, and identify missing troubleshooting or citation needs.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Outline
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin a new article from a topic idea.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create an outline for an article about [topic]. Ask about audience, goal, tone, length, and research needs first.

prompt_templates.title: Research a Section
prompt_templates.scenario: Add evidence before drafting a body section.
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [specific claim or topic] for my article. Summarize key findings, suggest credible sources, and show where citations should go.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Draft Section
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve one completed section before moving on.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my [section name] section for clarity, flow, evidence, and voice. Suggest specific edits and ask any missing questions.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Final Editorial Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a complete draft for publication.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my full draft for structure, argument strength, citation gaps, readability, title options, and final polish. Prioritize issues by impact.

output_examples.input: I am writing about remote onboarding. Help me outline the article.
output: A clear hook about the first week experience.
Main sections covering manager preparation, documentation, social connection, and success metrics.
Research tasks for onboarding data, employee survey findings, and example checklists.

output_examples.input: Find support for my claim that product discovery reduces wasted work.
output: A short research brief with candidate sources and evidence types.
Suggested citation placements next to unsupported claims.
Questions to verify whether the sources fit the target audience.

output_examples.input: Review my conclusion before I publish.
output: Feedback on whether the conclusion restates the main argument clearly.
Suggestions for a stronger final sentence and call to action.
A checklist for citations, flow, readability, and proofreading.

best_practices: Share the target audience, goal, tone, and desired length before outlining.
Provide source preferences and citation style before research begins.
Review one section at a time to preserve voice and reduce rework.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for citations without checking source quality and publication dates.
Do not request a full rewrite when you only need focused feedback.
Do not use generated examples as facts unless they are verified.

faq.question: Can this skill write a full article from scratch?
faq.answer: It can guide drafting from outline to polish, but you should provide goals, audience, sources, and final approval.

faq.question: Does it verify every citation automatically?
faq.answer: No. Citation accuracy depends on available browsing, supplied sources, and human review.

faq.question: Can it preserve my writing style?
faq.answer: Yes, if you provide examples, tone preferences, and feedback when suggestions do not match your voice.

faq.question: Is this useful for technical documentation?
faq.answer: Yes. It can outline tutorials, improve explanations, and identify missing troubleshooting or source details.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I prepare before using it?
faq.answer: Prepare the topic, audience, target format, existing notes, source requirements, and any style examples.
